record.paper_title: Open problems of the 32nd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings
record.original_question: With χℓ(G) denoting the list-chromatic number of a graph G and χ⋆ℓ(G) denoting the least k such that every k-list-assignment of G admits k pairwise disjoint proper L-colorings, is the inequality χ⋆ℓ(G) ≤ 2χℓ(G) true for every graph G?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.2 Is it true that χ⋆ ℓ(G)≤2 χ ℓ(G)for every graph G?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a (finite, simple) graph. A list assignment for $G$ is a function $L$ that assigns to every vertex $v\in V$ a set $L(v)$ of colors; it is a $k$-list-assignment if $|L(v)|=k$ for all $v\in V$. A proper $L$-coloring of $G$ is a function $c:V\to\bigcup_v L(v)$ with $c(v)\in L(v)$ for every $v$ and $c(u)\neq c(v)$ whenever $uv\in E$. The list-chromatic number $\chi_\ell(G)$ is the least integer $k$ such that every $k$-list-assignment of $G$ admits a proper $L$-coloring.

Given a $k$-list-assignment $L$, an $L$-packing of size $k$ is a collection of $k$ proper $L$-colorings $c_1,\dots,c_k$ such that for every $v\in V$ the multiset $\{c_1(v),\dots,c_k(v)\}$ equals the set $L(v)$ (equivalently, the $k$ colorings are pairwise disjoint at every vertex). Define the list packing number $\chi^\star_\ell(G)$ to be the least integer $k$ such that every $k$-list-assignment of $G$ admits an $L$-packing of size $k$.

Question: Is it true that $\chi^\star_\ell(G)\le 2\,\chi_\ell(G)$ for every graph $G$?
artifact.status_search_result: The list packing number $\chi^\star_\ell$ was introduced by Cambie, Cames van Batenburg, Davies and Kang (2021/2024), and bounding it linearly in $\chi_\ell$ remains a central open question in this line of work. Recent papers (e.g., on list packing for bounded-degree graphs, 2023, and fractional list packing, 2024–2025) state the conjecture that $\chi^\star_\ell(G) \le C\cdot \chi_\ell(G)$ for some constant $C$ (with $C=2$ as the strongest natural form) as an open problem; no proof or counterexample appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Packing list-colourings
status_evidence.snippet: Basic upper bounds on the smallest k for which such a list-packing is always guaranteed... do not yet rule out the prospect that the minimal k is not too much larger than the list chromatic number.
status_evidence.claim: Whether the list packing number is bounded by a constant multiple of the list chromatic number is left open.

status_evidence.title: List packing number of bounded degree graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Results highlight the subtleties of list packing and the barriers to a Brooks'-type theorem for the list packing number.
status_evidence.claim: List packing remains poorly understood compared to ordinary list coloring; linear comparison conjectures remain open.

status_evidence.title: Fractional List Packing for Layered Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: A conjecture states that there exists C>0 such that chi_l^bullet(G) <= C * chi_l(G) for any graph G.
status_evidence.claim: Linear-in-chi_l upper bounds for list packing variants are conjectural.
